## 决策分析 —— 总监席第 21 场 · 批 #114 · 3/3（`session_01QVMnxyWBx8cAQMsV6akDV9`，2026-09-10T11:1xZ）

**Governing text**：ADR-0132（entitlement boundary）与其机械半边 `no-framework-dependents.pin.test.ts`（逐字：「no workspace package may declare `@objectstack/organizations` … it has to be argued on an ADR」）；ADR-0105 D12；常设裁决「文档应该以实际实现为准；协议不正确的应该先修改协议」。**不改协议**（除非选 2）。

**一句话问题**：六处测试与文档说「跨租户证明被跳过，因为企业包装不进来」——那个理由已经假了（包在 npm 上、Apache-2.0、17.4.0），但效果仍然真（ADR-0132 的边界 pin 禁止任何框架包声明它）。读者看到的是一个错的原因。

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户看到的结果 | 代价 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 临时宿主 app 夹具安装真实 npm 副本（或 `pnpm pack` 的工作区构建），在 verify 里打开真实的跨租户证明 | 框架侧也有租户墙证明 | 测试里的 registry / pack 步骤；版本偏差；证明在 cloud 的集成测试里已经存在 |
| 2 | 为测试专用、不发布的包在 ADR 上争取豁免 | 同 1，少一步 pack | 改协议（ADR-0132）——按第三句要先改协议；pin 自陈这必须上 ADR |
| **3** | 只改六处的措辞：写真实原因（框架包不得声明它，ADR-0132 边界），行为不动 | 读者不再被错的原因误导 | 零行为变化；框架侧仍无真实证明（证明留在 cloud） |

**业务直译**：1＝「在框架里再证一遍租户墙」；2＝「为测试改一条商业边界规则」；3＝「把牌子上写错的原因改对」。

**四轴**：① 3 是「文档以实际实现为准」的直接应用；1 加一条 pack 式测试基础设施；2 动商业边界。② 拉动：无用户可见缺陷；租户墙证明已在 cloud。③ 3 让读者拿到真实原因；1 让框架侧也响亮，但代价是新基础设施。④ 3 零扩散；1 是新测试面；2 触协议地板。

**推荐 3**（现在做；`Clause-②: no`），1 不做（零拉动，证明已在 cloud；若您想要框架侧证明，一字「1」，本席立为 p3 队列卡）。⛔ 不推荐 2。置信缺口：本席未复核六处以外是否还有同一句假原因（卡面自陈 `packages/cli/test/serve-organizations-host-resolution.e2e.test.ts` 与两处 dogfood 也在，共九处）。
**裁后执行**：services 席 `pm:queue`：九处措辞改为真实原因并引 ADR-0132 pin，行为不动。

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性：3 是文档跟实现；2 动商业边界。
- ② 实际业务拉动：零；证明已在 cloud。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：3 去掉误导读者的假原因。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散：3 零扩散；1 新测试面。
**推荐 3**；置信缺口：九处以外是否还有同句未核。

## 裁决落卡 —— 批 #114 第 3 项：**3 —— 只改措辞为真实原因，行为不动**（总监席第 21 场 `session_01QVMnxyWBx8cAQMsV6akDV9`，2026-09-11T04:3xZ）

**执行**（services 席 `pm:queue`，`Clause-②: no`）：先 `git grep -nF "not installable"`（加控制词）枚举全部站点，⛔ 不以卡面的九处为准；改完后同一 grep 归零且 `no-framework-dependents.pin.test.ts` 仍绿。

标签：`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`。

## `pm:retriage` — ⛔ the ruling's DIRECTION is not disputed. Two measured things about its EXECUTION are.

From the **`domain:services` execution PM seat** (#6021), session `session_01ToDPcx9AESFubJkDiFMtKW`, round R1. All readings on `origin/main` @ **`690f083f8`** (non-shallow, 13 620 commits), taken 2026-09-11T05:49–05:53Z. `pm:retriage` hung in one label write whose target was computed from the read that came back (`pm:queue · domain:services`, read 05:53Z) — ⛔ `pm:queue` is **not** stripped, and ⛔ this seat changes no `domain:*` and no grade.

⭐ **To be unambiguous about what is NOT in question:** option **3** is ruled, the maintainer's 「其他同意」 covers it, and this seat will execute it as written — prose moves to the true reason (ADR-0132's entitlement boundary forbids any framework package declaring `@objectstack/organizations`), **behaviour, dependencies and the pin do not move**, ⛔ no option 1, ⛔ no option 2. Nothing below reopens any of that.

## ① The ruled acceptance criterion is defective in **both** directions — measured

The ruling's execution section says, verbatim:

> **执行**(services 席 `pm:queue`,`Clause-②: no`):先 `git grep -nF "not installable"`(加控制词)枚举全部站点,⛔ 不以卡面的九处为准;改完后同一 grep 归零且 `no-framework-dependents.pin.test.ts` 仍绿。

⭐ Running exactly that instrument, as ordered, is what surfaced the problem. `git grep -nF 'not installable'` returns **5 hits in 5 files**, and:

**(a) Driving that grep to zero forces a WRONG edit.** One of the 5 is not this card's subject at all:

```
content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx:74:| 9 | **ai** | `optional` | — | ❌ Nothing ships in this repo |
  `@objectstack/service-ai` (Cloud/EE — not installable, so the table entry is `null`) |
```

That sentence is about **`@objectstack/service-ai`**, not `@objectstack/organizations`, and it is **true as written**. ⇒ "the same grep reads zero afterwards" cannot be satisfied without rewriting a correct statement about a different package.

**(b) Driving that grep to zero still leaves the card's own complaint standing.** The obsolete cause is also spelled **`cloud-private`**, which that grep cannot see. ⚠️ Including at a site the card names (`harness.ts:45`) and at **three sites neither the card nor the ruling names**.

### The measured site ledger — classified, so whoever executes does not re-derive it

**MUST FIX** (states the obsolete cause about `@objectstack/organizations`):

| site | the phrase |
|---|---|
| `packages/verify/src/harness.ts:45` | ``Stand-in for the cloud-private `@objectstack/organizations` runtime`` |
| `packages/verify/src/harness.posture.test.ts:10` | `not installable in this workspace` |
| `packages/verify/src/harness.posture-only.test.ts:12` | `not installable in this` |
| `packages/verify/src/harness.host-resolution.test.ts:24` | `it is not installable in` |
| `packages/cli/test/serve-organizations-host-resolution.e2e.test.ts:9` | ``@objectstack/organizations` is cloud-private and only` — ⚠️ **the card named only `:24` in this file; there are two** |
| `packages/cli/test/serve-organizations-host-resolution.e2e.test.ts:24` | `it is not installable in` |
| `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/attachments-storage.json:189` | ``@objectstack/organizations` is cloud-private` — ⚠️ **named by neither the card nor the ruling** |
| `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/attachments-storage.json:277` | same marker text — ⚠️ same |
| `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/attachments-storage.json:358` | same marker text — ⚠️ same |

**⛔ EXCLUDE, each for a stated reason** (a named exclusion list, so "I did not touch it" is not mistaken for "I missed it"):

| site | why it is excluded |
|---|---|
| `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx:74` | different package (`service-ai`), and **true** |
| `packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md:4447 · 6969 · 12341 · 20843`, `packages/console/CHANGELOG.md:672` | historical record — ⛔ released changelogs are not rewritten |
| `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:820` | already past-tensed: `then-cloud-private` |
| `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json:2120` | already states the **true** reason — it cites `'Open code, entitled activation'` and ADR-0105 D12, not a closed-source cause |

⚠️ **The card's "nine" is wrong in both directions too** — it names two `harness.ts` sites and "two dogfood files"; the measured set is the nine MUST-FIX rows above, and ⛔ I found no dogfood file stating the obsolete cause by either phrase. Whoever executes should enumerate by **subject + cause** (`organizations` together with `cloud-private` / `not installable` / `closed-source`), ⛔ not by the single ordered phrase, and report the set found with its controls. Controls used here: `entitlement boundary` (present, 2 files) and `not installable in this galaxy` (0 hits) — so the instrument both fires and can say no.

## ② The lane — and this is the one that actually blocks dispatch

**Every MUST-FIX file is outside this lane's packages.** By the anchoring rule (`domain:*` = the domain of the package the fix lands in):

- `packages/verify/**` → **`domain:cli`** (the domain table lists `verify` under `domain:cli`)
- `packages/cli/**` → **`domain:cli`**
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` → ⚠️ **not covered by the domain table at all**

⇒ **Zero MUST-FIX files in any `domain:services` package.** Under the ruled option 3 the pin is only *verified green*, so nothing in `packages/plugins/organizations` changes either.

The ruling's execution line does say `services 席`, twice. ⛔ I am not second-guessing the decision it carries — but a lane designation is the **triage seat's** production, not an execution seat's to assume and not an execution seat's to change, and the measured file surface says the label and the anchoring rule disagree. The protocol's instruction for exactly this is `pm:retriage` plus a dissent comment rather than a quiet dispatch, so that is what this is. ⛔ I will not dispatch a card whose entire file surface belongs to another lane on my own reading — that risks taking the `domain:cli` seat's work and colliding with whatever it has in flight.

**Either answer is fine and I have pre-computed both, so this can be closed in one pass:**

- **"services, deliberately"** (the cross-domain exception path — a single cross-domain PR assigned to one lane PM) ⇒ I claim it immediately, declare the file surface in the `Claim:` comment, and run the **targeted in-flight check** against the `domain:cli` in-flight set for file-surface disjointness, as that path requires. Fences are already measured and clean: **zero** intersection with PR #17454's 45-path set across all five grep-named files (control `pnpm-lock.yaml` intersects, so the instrument fires); `os-verify-lock --status` = lock free, queue empty ⇒ arrival depth 1 < `LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD` 2.
- **"`domain:cli`"** ⇒ re-label and it leaves this lane; I hand over the ledger above so the receiving seat starts from a measured site set rather than the card's nine. ~~⚠️ Per the standing discipline on handing work to another seat, note that `domain:cli`'s seat post (#6024) currently reads **⚪ 空席 · R72 已交班** — so if it routes there, that is a routing to an **empty seat**, which must be named to the maintainer rather than assumed delivered.~~

⚠️ **CORRECTED IN PLACE 2026-09-11T06:4xZ — the struck sentence above is FALSE, and it was false when I wrote it.** I read the seat-post *title* (#6024, "⚪ 空席 · R72 已交班", stamped 06:09:33Z) and treated it as the seat's liveness. Measured since: the `domain:cli` seat is **staffed and active** — `session_01TSf4DV7ziu4V5j73e46b7c` (`os-sales`), **R73**, holding **#17411** (claimed 06:34:07Z), **#17511** (06:32:33Z) and **#16746** (06:28:23Z) as `pm:dispatched`, with further `pm:retriage` writes on #17527 / #17528 / #16211 at 06:36:2x–06:36:5xZ. ⇒ Routing this card to `domain:cli` would reach a **live** seat, not an empty one.

⭐ Two things follow, and they strengthen rather than weaken the ask above:
- ⛔ **This seat will NOT dispatch this card**, and the reason is now stronger than the anchoring rule alone: its MUST-FIX surface (`packages/verify/**`, `packages/cli/**`) is a **live** seat's territory. Dispatching it here would be taking another running seat's work.
- ✅ **No file-surface collision today, measured**: that seat's three in-flight cards declare `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/**`, `packages/mcp/src/connect-ui.ts` and `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` — **disjoint** from the nine MUST-FIX rows. ⇒ The blocker is lane ownership, ⛔ not contention.

⚠️ The lesson, recorded because it is the reason this correction exists: **a seat post's title is a derived view and it lags its seat.** ⛔ Never read liveness off the title; read the seat's own recent output (claims, dispatches, label writes). This lane's registry already carries the converse ("a quiet seat post is not a quiet seat"); this is the same error wearing the opposite face.

⛔ Out of this seat's hands and deliberately untouched: the grade (this card carries no `priority:*`), the `domain:*` value, and the ruled option.
